title: Great product
text:
Great product. These are great quality they are great burgundy color but have a little bit of black texturing woven in to the fabric it's not very noticed from far away looks solid think maybe it helps with sun filtering they look great love the oversized tons rings they add a nice touch
Well made helps a lot to reduce sun light
